subject: Wellbridge vendor review: transfer controls, DPA annex & DPF evidence
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@wellbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@wellbridge.com
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: RFP: data protection controls & transborder transfers

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for responding to our vendor RFP. The Security & Privacy review team at Wellbridge is collecting the following from shortlisted vendors as part of our procurement gating:

- A DPF/DPF-equivalent evidence pack showing technical and organisational measures (encryption, KMS, audit logging, retention controls).
- A DPA annex (redline if you have one) that maps to our clause set (we expect SCCs + DPA annex for EU controllers; please confirm).
- Cross-border transfer mapping (EU->US, EU->APAC) and which safeguards you rely on (Standard Contractual Clauses, DPF, UK Addendum).
- An operational runbook describing incident escalation and audit log retention for three years.
- For customers with regulated data we also require notes on Private (VPC/on‑prem) deployment options and an installer/runbook.

Can you share an evidence pack and indicate a realistic timeline for our legal/compliance review (we're aiming to complete vendor review within three weeks from receipt)?

Also please attach any SOC2 or third-party audit artifacts and any template DPA annex you prefer us to review.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Senior Manager, Vendor Risk
Wellbridge Health

Attachment: wellbridge_rfi_responses.xlsx (we've shared our questionnaire)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: data protection controls & transborder transfers

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list and the questionnaire. Looping in Laura (Privacy) and Rishi (Security) so they can pick up the detailed artifacts.

Quick answers and next steps:

1) Evidence pack: attaching our initial evidence bundle and a mapping spreadsheet for SCC/DPF coverage. Files attached: redwood_dpf_evidence_v1.pdf; scc-mapping-tokyo.csv. The pack includes KMS architecture notes, audit log retention (3 yrs default), and an encryption-at-rest/in-transit summary.

2) DPA annex: we'll provide a draft DPA annex redline (dpa-annex-draft.docx) that maps to your clause list. Our standard approach is to rely on EU SCCs + DPF equivalence statements; we can include the UK Addendum if required. Quick Q: do you require wording that explicitly calls out subprocessor locations in APAC? If so, point us to the specific clause in your workbook.

3) Private/on‑prem: we have a documented on‑prem installer and runbook (runbook-onprem.md). It includes networking, KMS integration options (customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM), and a short checklist for air-gapped deployments.

4) Timelines: we'll aim to get the full DPA annex redline and an expanded evidence pack to you within 4 business days (end of week). SOC2 Type II report link is included here: https://redwood-internal/reports/soc2-type2-2027.pdf.

5) Other asks: if you can mark the items in the workbook that are critical vs nice-to-have, we'll prioritize those in the redline.

We attached: redwood_dpf_evidence_v1.pdf, scc-mapping-tokyo.csv.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@wellbridge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: compliance@wellbridge.com, pm@wellbridge.com
Date: Wed, 15 Mar 2028 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: data protection controls & transborder transfers

Karthik — appreciate the quick turnaround and the initial artifacts. A few clarifications from our side:

- We typically require the EU SCCs (controller-processor) plus a DPA annex that references clause 10.2 (subprocessor notification) and describes your cross-border safeguards. An Addendum for UK transfers is preferred but not mandatory if the SCCs + DPF mapping are complete.
- For APAC/Tokyo specifically, we need to see the subprocessor list and the mapping showing how you transfer logs or backups (if any).
- Our SOC2 is reviewed by the procurement team; the SOC2 link is sufficient for now.

I've updated the worksheet to flag critical items (column: REVIEW_PRIORITY = HIGH). File attached: wellbridge_rfi_responses.xlsx (same workbook as before, tabs: Controls, Dataflow, LegalClauses).

If you can provide the DPA annex redline and the subprocessor mapping for APAC by Friday EOD, we'll keep you on track for the three-week review.

Thanks,
Marta

> On Tue, Mar 14, 2028 at 10:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> > ...We'll aim to get the full DPA annex redline and an expanded evidence pack to you within 4 business days (end of week).
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@wellbridge.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Mar 2028 16:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: RFP: data protection controls & transborder transfers

Thanks for the priority flags — that helps. Next steps from our side:

- Deliverables by Fri 17 Mar EOD (attached to this thread): dpa-annex-draft.docx (redline), updated redwood_dpf_evidence_v2.pdf (includes APAC subprocessor mapping), scc-mapping-tokyo.csv.
- Operational runbook (runbook-onprem.md) is attached; it includes steps for on‑prem installation, KMS/HSM integration notes, and audit log export configuration.
- We will also provide a short tech note on how we isolate EU traffic and the automated fallback policies if hosted capacity crosses regional boundaries.

If you want us to produce a short 20‑minute walkthrough of the annex and evidence pack for your legal team, Laura can host that next Tuesday (24 Mar) or earlier if needed.

Finally, we'll prepare a concise summary table keyed to your REVIEW_PRIORITY column so your team can tick-off items quickly.

Best,
Karthik

Attachments: dpa-annex-draft.docx; redwood_dpf_evidence_v2.pdf; scc-mapping-tokyo.csv; runbook-onprem.md

Karthik — thanks, received the redline and the evidence pack. We'll review internally and get back with any follow-up questions. We may take you up on the walkthrough if legal wants it.

Best regards,
Marta
